| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/patrickmurphypa/p/let-veterans-use-the-gi-bill-for?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

These days, you can hardly go a day without someone talking about artificial intelligence. What few people outside the tech world realize is that the AI revolution is also one of the largest construction projects in human history. Across the country, the physical infrastructure of the next economy is being built, including the factories that make advanced chips, the data centers that power AI, and the electrical systems needed to keep all of it running. BlackRock's CEO Larry Fink[ estimates the world needs $68 trillion in new infrastructure by 2040](https://substack.com/redirect/4244eb22-c056-4434-9cc8-187d79991130?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
There is just one problem: America does not have enough skilled workers to build any of it.
For decades, we told young people that the safest path to a good life ran through a four-year college. The trades were treated as a lesser option, suitable for people who lacked either the means or the ambition to pursue a white-collar career. "Learn to code" became both a cultural punchline and a serious piece of career advice.
Now the joke has turned on them.
The cruel irony is that college graduates (especially those who studied computer science) are struggling to find entry-level work. Meanwhile, there is an enormous demand for skilled tradespeople who can wire a data center and install the miles of pipe needed to bring a semiconductor plant online. Many of the white-collar jobs once considered safest are now among the easiest for artificial intelligence to disrupt. Junior software engineering roles are becoming harder to find as companies use AI to automate more basic coding work. The jobs proving hardest to automate are the ones that still require a skilled human being to show up and work with their hands.
Hidden inside this workforce crisis is an enormous opportunity.
Every year, about 200,000 Americans leave the military and return to civilian life. Today, I'll be at Dover Air Force Base helping hundreds of them understand their options through the U.S. Chamber of Commerce [Hiring Our Heroes](https://substack.com/redirect/40af85e9-90c8-4e80-8331-d7ed4268d597?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Career Summit, one of many free events that reach more than 80,000 troops a year. These young patriots already possess many of the qualities that are needed right now. Military experience demands physical stamina and technical training. That background makes veterans a natural fit for the skilled trades. Bryce Barnes, a West Point graduate, former Army platoon leader, and now a construction leader in Nashville, summed it up in Jason Altmire's book _[Trade Up](https://substack.com/redirect/a9361307-9c50-463a-985f-cd62f0c2139b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)_ , saying that veterans bring intangible characteristics and experience, such as the ability to overcome adversity and adapt under pressure. It's why he believes that so many veterans choose construction as a career. According to the VA, [more than 528,000 veterans work in construction](https://substack.com/redirect/c523f01d-d661-4540-b8c2-65ee5c5dc2af?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The match between vets and trades should be obvious. America needs skilled workers and veterans need good, stable careers. Apprenticeships connect the two.
[Ninety percent](https://substack.com/redirect/f43a23b5-fd5e-4cb6-bea3-bb82bf6cf1e4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of people who finish a registered apprenticeship are still employed afterward, with an average starting salary around [$80,000](https://substack.com/redirect/ebfed984-5cb1-4228-958f-137cb5b1ccc1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The pipeline works, yet the GI Bill in its current form gives less support for vets who choose an apprenticeship compared to those who choose college.
In 2008, we both teamed up as[ original cosponsors of the Post-9/11 GI Bill](https://substack.com/redirect/60e2d3f9-cd4c-4a74-b9d7-838be7800ec8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), when veteran unemployment was over 16 percent. Getting it passed is one of our proudest accomplishments during our time on the Hill. It has sent millions of veterans to college and changed lives, reducing veteran unemployment to under 3 percent. At the time, trades were still an afterthought. Our world has changed dramatically since then, and the law needs to change with it.
A veteran pursuing a four-year degree can receive a monthly housing allowance that remains steady throughout school, while a veteran using the same GI Bill for an apprenticeship sees that allowance drop by [20 percent every six months](https://substack.com/redirect/2a7311a4-85f7-4204-9ddc-74100b285af2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Because most apprenticeships last about two years, veterans receive only a fraction of the original housing benefit by the time they complete their training. And unlike veterans attending college, whose tuition and fees are paid directly to the school, veterans in apprenticeships don't see a dime for the cost of their training. In practice, the GI Bill rewards veterans for choosing a classroom and penalizes them for choosing the career path America most urgently needs filled today.
The good news is that Congress has a solution called the[ Reducing Arbitrary Barriers to Apprenticeship Act](https://substack.com/redirect/06b84539-3471-49c1-ac5a-7feda341df8b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) (S.3993). Tim Sheehy, a Montana Republican and former Navy SEAL, introduced the bill. Its cosponsors include Senator Elissa Slotkin (D-Mich.), a former CIA officer; Senator Tammy Duckworth (D-Ill.), an Iraq War veteran who lost both legs when her helicopter was shot down; Senator Kevin Cramer (R-N.D.); Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska), a Marine Corps veteran; and Senator Ruben Gallego (D-Ariz.), a Marine Corps combat veteran.
The bill would give veterans in apprenticeships the same full housing benefit available to those attending college and also remove the rigid monthly work-hour requirement that can punish construction apprentices when bad weather or seasonal slowdowns reduce the hours available. In other words, it would stop the GI Bill from steering veterans away from the trades and finally treat those careers as equal to a traditional college education.
Currently, only about [2 percent of veterans](https://substack.com/redirect/2a7311a4-85f7-4204-9ddc-74100b285af2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) use the GI Bill for apprenticeships or on-the-job training. If this bill passes, more veterans would be empowered to pursue that path.
[The American Legion](https://substack.com/redirect/80af7aa2-703b-4193-a8f6-8b14ea0fb7b2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the largest veterans organization in the country, supports the bill. Now Congress should too. Everyone with a stake in this already knows the trades are a good bet for veterans, and for the country. This bill isn't only about helping veterans. It's also about recognizing that the skilled trades were never the lesser path. They are stable, well-paying careers America cannot function without, and it's time our laws treat them with the full respect they deserve.
Thanks for reading all the way to the end. If these issues matter to you, please consider a free or paid subscription.

It's time to let veterans pursue the skilled trades with the same GI Bill benefits as those attending college. | | ---|---|--- | | | Forwarded this email? ? for more ? Thank you for supporting my work. If my writing resonates with you, consider . Annual paid subscribers will receive a digital copy of my 2008 memoir, . * Most Americans don't have a college degree. It's time to let veterans pursue the skilled trades with the same GI Bill benefits as those attending college. | | and | Jul 14 | | | ---|---|--- | | | | | | | | | | | These days, you can hardly go a day without someone talking about artificial intelligence. What few people outside the tech world realize is that the AI revolution is also one of the largest construction projects in human history. Across the country, the physical infrastructure of the next economy is being built, including the factories that make advanced chips, the data centers that power AI, and the electrical systems needed to keep all of it running. BlackRock's CEO Larry Fink. There is just one problem: America does not have enough skilled workers to build any of it. For decades, we told young people that the safest path to a good life ran through a four-year college. The trades were treated as a lesser option, suitable for people who lacked either the means or the ambition to pursue a white-collar career. "Learn to code" became both a cultural punchline and a serious piece of career advice. Now the joke has turned on them. The cruel irony is that college graduates (especially those who studied computer science) are struggling to find entry-level work. Meanwhile, there is an enormous demand for skilled tradespeople who can wire a data center and install the miles of pipe needed to bring a semiconductor plant online. Many of the white-collar jobs once considered safest are now among the easiest for artificial intelligence to disrupt. Junior software engineering roles are becoming harder to find as companies use AI to automate more basic coding work. The jobs proving hardest to automate are the ones that still require a skilled human being to show up and work with their hands. Hidden inside this workforce crisis is an enormous opportunity. Every year, about 200,000 Americans leave the military and return to civilian life. Today, I'll be at Dover Air Force Base helping hundreds of them understand their options through the U.S. Chamber of Commerce Career Summit, one of many free events that reach more than 80,000 troops a year. These young patriots already possess many of the qualities that are needed right now. Military experience demands physical stamina and technical training. That background makes veterans a natural fit for the skilled trades. Bryce Barnes, a West Point graduate, former Army platoon leader, and now a construction leader in Nashville, summed it up in Jason Altmire's book , saying that veterans bring intangible characteristics and experience, such as the ability to overcome adversity and adapt under pressure. It's why he believes that so many veterans choose construction as a career. According to the VA, . The match between vets and trades should be obvious. America needs skilled workers and veterans need good, stable careers. Apprenticeships connect the two. of people who finish a registered apprenticeship are still employed afterward, with an average starting salary around . The pipeline works, yet the GI Bill in its current form gives less support for vets who choose an apprenticeship compared to those who choose college. In 2008, we both teamed up as, when veteran unemployment was over 16 percent. Getting it passed is one of our proudest accomplishments during our time on the Hill. It has sent millions of veterans to college and changed lives, reducing veteran unemployment to under 3 percent. At the time, trades were still an afterthought. Our world has changed dramatically since then, and the law needs to change with it. A veteran pursuing a four-year degree can receive a monthly housing allowance that remains steady throughout school, while a veteran using the same GI Bill for an apprenticeship sees that allowance drop by . Because most apprenticeships last about two years, veterans receive only a fraction of the original housing benefit by the time they complete their training. And unlike veterans attending college, whose tuition and fees are paid directly to the school, veterans in apprenticeships don't see a dime for the cost of their training. In practice, the GI Bill rewards veterans for choosing a classroom and penalizes them for choosing the career path America most urgently needs filled today. The good news is that Congress has a solution called the (S.3993). Tim Sheehy, a Montana Republican and former Navy SEAL, introduced the bill. Its cosponsors include Senator Elissa Slotkin (D-Mich.), a former CIA officer; Senator Tammy Duckworth (D-Ill.), an Iraq War veteran who lost both legs when her helicopter was shot down; Senator Kevin Cramer (R-N.D.); Senator Dan Sullivan (R-Alaska), a Marine Corps veteran; and Senator Ruben Gallego (D-Ariz.), a Marine Corps combat veteran. The bill would give veterans in apprenticeships the same full housing benefit available to those attending college and also remove the rigid monthly work-hour requirement that can punish construction apprentices when bad weather or seasonal slowdowns reduce the hours available. In other words, it would stop the GI Bill from steering veterans away from the trades and finally treat those careers as equal to a traditional college education. Currently, only about use the GI Bill for apprenticeships or on-the-job training. If this bill passes, more veterans would be empowered to pursue that path. , the largest veterans organization in the country, supports the bill. Now Congress should too. Everyone with a stake in this already knows the trades are a good bet for veterans, and for the country. This bill isn't only about helping veterans. It's also about recognizing that the skilled trades were never the lesser path. They are stable, well-paying careers America cannot function without, and it's time our laws treat them with the full respect they deserve. Thanks for reading all the way to the end. subject: I'm asking you today to chip in $5—or whatever you can afford.

body:
And all over the 8th district people are fired up!

| | | | | |
---
| | | | |
---
| | Hello Peter,
I have one question for you...
**What can $5 do?**
It can buy campaign literature that helps persuade undecided voters.It can help put another yard sign in front of a home.It can help fuel another trip across our district.
And when thousands of people each give just a few dollars, it becomes the people-powered movement that can defeat big-money politics.
I'm asking you today to [chip in **$5**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=b811cef506&e=c6e7dff14c)**—or whatever you can afford.**
Because this campaign isn't slowing down.
We're speeding up.
Over the past several days, I've been criss-crossing Ohio's 8th Congressional District, meeting voters where they are. Yesterday I had the opportunity to speak with voters in **Troy, Ohio.** Not long before that, I made a surprise trip to **Eaton** to hear directly from families there.
And everywhere I go, I hear the same thing:**People are ready for change.**
Our rural communities are fired up.
They're tired of watching politicians play footsies with a Republican Party that is determined to divide our country while working families struggle to get by.
Gas prices are climbing.Food prices keep rising.Families are working harder than ever, but everything costs more.People are asking a simple question:
**Who's fighting for us?**
My answer is simple:
**We are.**
That's why our volunteers are on the phones every day.That's why we're knocking on doors across the district.That's why we're talking to voters one conversation at a time and reminding them that this election is too important to sit out.
And this week is going to be one of our biggest yet.

### 🎯 Wednesday: The Ground Game
We're bringing together volunteers and Precinct Executives from across Ohio's 8th District for an evening of strategy, fellowship, and fun as we prepare for our district-wide takeover.
**The Ground Game**
**Wednesday | 6:00–8:00 PM**
College Station Bar & Grill
1579 Goodman Ave.
Cincinnati, OH 45224
Come early...
Because I've been told the chicken wings disappear faster than campaign signs!We'll laugh together, build relationships, talk strategy, and prepare for the work ahead.

### 🚪 Saturday: John Lewis Good Trouble Weekend of Action

Then on **Saturday, July 18 at 10:00 AM** , we're joining forces for one of the largest canvasses of the campaign with Representative Karen Brownlee, Senate candidate Cara Jacobs, and State House candidate Jonathan Bradner.We'll be knocking doors throughout Forest Park, Green Hills, and Pleasant Run Farms.
**Starting Location:**
1280 W. Kemper Rd.
Cincinnati, OH 45240
Never knocked doors before?
Perfect.
It's more fun than you think—especially when you're surrounded by 80 or 90 new friends who believe we can change Ohio together.
And if walking isn't your thing, we've got you covered.
Join our **Honk & Wave** team, hold campaign signs, cheer on volunteers, and help us show our neighbors that hope is alive in Ohio's 8th District.
Every volunteer matters.Every conversation matters.Every neighborhood matters.And every vote matters.
We're fighting to restore integrity to government.We're fighting to protect Social Security.We're fighting for working families.We're fighting for communities that have been ignored for far too long.
Most importantly...
**We're fighting to win.**
You can learn more, volunteer, and RSVP for upcoming events at:[**www.enochforcongress.com/events**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=2ef39d6ec5&e=c6e7dff14c)
If you're tired of yelling at the television every night...If you're wondering what you can actually do...Get off the sidelines and join the fight.
Some of our organizing activities aren't listed on our public calendar, so if you'd like to hear about our "top secret" volunteer opportunities, sign up to volunteer through [CampaignHQ ](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=b0e98a5c48&e=c6e7dff14c)and become part of the team that's building this movement from the ground up.
Now here's where I need your help.We're running low on campaign literature.We're running low on yard signs.But we are **not** running low on determination.
Can you [chip in **just $5 today**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=bdbc6df7dc&e=c6e7dff14c)**?**
Five dollars won't change your life.
But combined with thousands of other grassroots supporters, it can absolutely change this election.
If you can give more, we're grateful.
If you can only [give $5](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=94373b00d7&e=c6e7dff14c), you're exactly the kind of grassroots supporter this campaign is built on.
And if you can't give today, join us this week, bring a friend, knock a few doors, wave a sign, or simply help spread the word.
Together, we're proving that people—not special interests—still have the power to change America.
Let's go win Ohio's 8th.
With gratitude,
**Dr. Vanessa Enoch**
Democratic Candidate for Congress
Ohio's 8th Congressional District
P.S. Every flyer, every yard sign, every tank of gas, and every voter contact brings us one step closer to victory. Please [chip in **$5 today**](https://enochforcongress.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=488c703b71891f0b712737c99&id=b90d87722a&e=c6e7dff14c) —or whatever you can—and help us keep this movement growing.

Peter,
There is a reckoning coming for MAGA politicians in the Heartland who have sold out their constituents to support Trump. Nebraska is Ground Zero.
No one is at more risk than Congressman Mike Flood (R-NE), the extreme far-right representative for Nebraska's First Congressional District, known for introducing the nation's first 20 week abortion ban.
To his credit, Rep. Flood is one of the few GOPs representatives in the nation willing to face his constituents at in person Town Halls with constituents in the district. What we are witnessing at them is nothing short of a full blown populist revolt -- he is getting torn apart.
---
| [](https://eeuwd7hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001DysYJ7I-QmZ8KcSDzuL1NAwPtk9tF9-aaykAwuOfv2ATFMgrFAs-u1glwev15D8A1rmE11-RThxDMHP7JYthlLJFBCaGO95UA7aeG1WvUcFV50d5eNDvg6-8UmBDwM9ztrBGcDh5DWOmJw-2jZ4MKKw4EAcy4yAqCU1GKZxciDMvvHDS8UyDT-g3foNLVgigdnO6LDxmTI7P3RPEp6xiBw==&c=KzshmwR60t2fIwx5deDKKqQN7vEhwpZ5Es5HK3cs0u7nUs3gjb2z7Q==&ch=sh-_FYgQpI38xnCy_-qaCEYrtOz00dx2yfmG9bhEKO_eojIz4MSEvw==)

A town hall Flood hosted in 2025 made national headlines after an attendee asked about how we can ensure access to healthcare for everyone, Flood responded: "We can't afford that" and was barely able to get a word out following the backlash from the crowd.
At Flood's most recent public event, he was heckled and booed relentlessly for his support for Trump's voter suppression bill the SAVE Act, for his unflinching support of Trump's ego-driven war on Iran, and for his refusal to do anything at all to lower prices for working families.

That means every dollar we spend to turn voters against MAGA Mike Flood, flip Nebraska's Second Congressional District from red to blue, and defeat Republican billionaire Senator Pete Ricketts has nearly triple the impact of other races.
Most states do not have two House seats, a competitive Senate seat, state house elections, and a Governor's race all tied up into the same election. Nebraska does.
We are the Democratic Party's most potent secret weapon for defeating MAGA this November. name: Chris Pappas
subject: I'm still sorry about Karoline Leavitt
body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=7726%2E582294%2ECo5rPF ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=7726%2E582294%2ECo5rPF ]Chris Pappas for Senate

Karoline
Leavitt is lying to you.

The other day I turned on the TV to see Karoline Leavitt at the White
House podium claiming, “Gas prices decreased over the past year,” – which
we both know couldn’t be further from the truth.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260714_1.WMJQin&refcode=em20260714-1&t=1003&akid=7726%2E582294%2ECo5rPF ]Karoline Leavitt is lying

Look, Granite Staters got the first taste of Karoline Leavitt’s MAGA spin
when she ran against me for Congress a few years ago. Voters saw right
through it and rejected her agenda — by nearly 10 points.

Now Karoline Leavitt is bringing those same talking points New Hampshire
voters dismissed to the national stage.

If you’re wondering how the rest of the country ended up having to listen
to Karoline Leavitt’s “spin,” it’s because New Hampshire proved something
important first: MAGA’s lies don’t hold up when you stay focused on real,
kitchen-table issues.

None of this has stopped the MAGA machine from trying again in NH.
National Republicans are planning to invest over 17 million dollars into
our state, because they think they can notch a win here to cling to their
Senate majority.

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260714_1.WMJQin&refcode=em20260714-1&t=1004&akid=7726%2E582294%2ECo5rPF ]But I’ve beaten their playbook before, and now I need your help to do
it again. Will you chip in $5 to help us keep this Senate
seat blue?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260714_1.WMJQin&amount=5&refcode=em20260714-1&t=1023&akid=7726%2E582294%2ECo5rPF ]Donate $5 »

If you believe New Hampshire should keep leading the way and showing the
rest of the country that MAGA politics don’t work here, I’m asking you to
be a part of our campaign.

Thanks for being in this fight with me.

Chris

name: NHGOP Headquarters
subject: Election Integrity Workers Needed! DEADLINE WEDNESDAY
body:
Election Integrity Workers Needed! DEADLINE WEDNESDAY

| | | | | | |
Good Day, INSPECTOR OF ELECTION APPOINTMENT DEADLINE IS THIS WEDNESDAY.
Free and fair elections don’t happen on their own; they happen because of hard-working people like you who show up. Last cycle, a lot of Republicans served our state as a Poll Challenger and/or Inspector of Elections, and the integrity of our polling was stronger because of it.
Another election is coming, and the Republican Party is counting on your help. Poll Challengers safeguard transparency by monitoring compliance with election laws while protecting voters’ rights and keeping order. Inspectors of the Election work for the moderator and keep Election Day running fairly and accurately, verifying checklists, processing voters, and handling ballots in accordance with New Hampshire law. Both roles are essential, and people like you are the backbone of the effort.
Training will be set up for both Inspectors of the Election and Poll Challengers.
We’d be grateful to have you serve. Reply to nhelectionintegrity@nhrsc.com and we’ll send over details on how to get you signed up.
Let’s make sure this election is handled right. We hope you’ll join uS.
For additional information, see the job descriptions below.
Best,
Scott MaltzieChairman New Hampshire Republican State Party
### Poll Challenger
A Poll Challenger is a designated representative of a political party or candidate who observes the voting process and may raise concerns regarding a voter's eligibility when there is a legitimate basis to do so. Poll Challengers help promote transparency and confidence in elections by monitoring compliance with election laws while respecting voters' rights and maintaining order at the polling place.
### Inspector of Elections
An Inspector of Elections is an election official appointed to assist in the administration of Election Day operations. Inspectors help verify voter checklists, process voters, maintain accurate election records, assist with ballot handling, and ensure election procedures are conducted fairly, accurately, and in accordance with New Hampshire law. They serve as part of the team responsible for the integrity and smooth operation of the polling place.Both roles need to participate in a training session and require an appointment letter from the Chairman of the State Party.Sincerely,

Scott MaltzieChairman

name: John Hickenlooper
subject: I never thought I'd run for office
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Heartland Patriots (LucasKunce
body:
This is a longer email about my story and how I came to fight for hardworking Coloradans in the Senate, and I hope you’ll read it until the end.
I'll be honest, Peter. I never saw myself serving in the U.S. Senate.
This is a longer email about my story and how I came to fight for hardworking Coloradans in the Senate, and I hope you’ll read it until the end. **[But if you don’t have time, please, take a moment and split a donation between Heartland Patriots and my campaign to help us take back the Senate. →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106299?refcode=em20260714-10675&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=10675%2E614464%2ENWgUld)**
**[DONATE →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106299?refcode=em20260714-10675&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=10675%2E614464%2ENWgUld)**
Back in the mid-1980s, I was a geologist — until I wasn’t. Our company got sold and we all got laid off. I used part of my severance to buy an old Chevy convertible, and drove to visit my brother in Berkeley, CA. He showed me one of the first brewpubs in America and I loved it. I came back to Denver and took a gamble, risking every scrap of my savings in opening the Wynkoop Brewing Company in downtown Denver.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/106299?refcode=em20260714-10675&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=10675%2E614464%2ENWgUld)
I remember working 80-hour weeks. I remember lying awake at night, wondering how we were going to make it. And I remember being so frustrated that our government was focusing more on decisions that’d help politicians get reelected rather than helping solve our problems.
So I ran for Mayor. To everyone’s surprise, especially mine, I won in a landslide. From then on, I focused every day on making decisions based on what was best for Denver.
I then became the first Denver Mayor in 120 years to be elected Governor, on the premise of uniting people and getting things done. We expanded health care to half a million people and created the first methane regulations in any state or country in the world.
And after we flipped Colorado’s Senate seat in 2020, we worked to deliver real change for Coloradans. We invested billions of dollars to confront the climate crisis, lowered prescription drug costs, made investments to rebuild our infrastructure, and brought thousands of good-paying manufacturing jobs back to America.
Now, we’re in the fight of our lives as Trump’s extreme agenda threatens to undo all that work. We refused to let him auction off our public lands or use your tax dollars to give handouts to felons like Tina Peters.
But look, I’ve also seen how broken Washington is – and how Trump has unleashed corruption like a pandemic. I see politicians who only listen to those who cut big campaign checks while ignoring families trying to afford health care. I’ve seen how Trump operates: money comes in, favors go out.
Here’s why I’m telling you this: **what drives our work is the people of Colorado.**
The families who are struggling to maintain their health insurance after Trump gutted the Affordable Care Act to give tax cuts to his friends in the Epstein class. The workers who are working full time and still need a second job to afford their rent. The kids who are studying science are already worried that the funding for their research will never come back.
As I said, I never thought I’d find myself in the U.S. Senate, but I’m running for re-election because it’s been the honor of a life-time to fight for you. And, too much is at stake to stop now.
That’s why I don't take money from corporate PACs like your typical politician. Instead, I rely on grassroots folks like you. And it’s why I'm depending on your contribution today to help us defend Colorado this November. Even just $5 here or $10 there goes a long way in a campaign like ours.

I came back to Denver and took a gamble, risking every scrap of my savings in opening the Wynkoop Brewing Company in downtown Denver. I remember working 80-hour weeks. I remember lying awake at night, wondering how we were going to make it. And I remember being so frustrated that our government was focusing more on decisions that’d help politicians get reelected rather than helping solve our problems. So I ran for Mayor. To everyone’s surprise, especially mine, I won in a landslide. From then on, I focused every day on making decisions based on what was best for Denver. I then became the first Denver Mayor in 120 years to be elected Governor, on the premise of uniting people and getting things done. We expanded health care to half a million people and created the first methane regulations in any state or country in the world. And after we flipped Colorado’s Senate seat in 2020, we worked to deliver real change for Coloradans. We invested billions of dollars to confront the climate crisis, lowered prescription drug costs, made investments to rebuild our infrastructure, and brought thousands of good-paying manufacturing jobs back to America. | | | Let’s talk about explosive watery diarrhea.

I'm Dr. Jasmine Clark, the Democratic nominee for Georgia's 13th District—and I have a Ph.D. in microbiology.

Right now, an outbreak of Cyclospora, a parasite that causes explosive watery diarrhea, is affecting people in 18 states, including Georgia. It can contaminate leafy greens and berries, and health officials are still trying to find the source.

Normally, we'd rely on the CDC to track outbreaks like this, identify where contaminated food came from, and help stop more people from getting sick.**

| | Politics Doesn't Have to Be Complicated

| | Politics can feel overwhelming, especially when the headlines never seem to stop. The good news is that understanding the issues that impact our families doesn't have to be complicated. Recorded live at CPAC, this week's podcast features two inspiring moms helping others make a difference. Erica Choinka, founder of Politics For Her, shares why public policy matters to moms and how she makes today's biggest issues easy to understand. Then, Julianna Ormond explains how her Watchman Action Training curriculum helps people turn passion into a practical plan for strengthening their communities. Whether you're just getting involved or looking for your next step, this conversation will encourage and equip you to make a difference where you live. Full episode available now on [YouTube](https://momsforamerica.us/so/ffPzWzuB2/c?w=C6RFnKmmVLdNKV_v3q6jKXlrTnUIBlAOcTpg9LVw8_w.), [Rumble](https://momsforamerica.us/so/ffPzWzuB2/c?w=ok3YM37MTc9ydMs_a2e5_QuzDkmhlF2IkQ8fXj7I8HY.), [Spotify](https://momsforamerica.us/so/ffPzWzuB2/c?w=Uu35uXJdbtEA5zMrhUgHvyMsNRBdd4dFUlEC79RvqHY.) and [Apple](https://momsforamerica.us/so/ffPzWzuB2/c?w=MGCecOo6jBee5NMVUIqhqmRGWUSMoNkX6uEFCRDe2eM.).

## 5 Ways Moms Can Save the Nation
---
| | [](https://momsforamerica.us/so/ffPzWzuB2/c?w=lOHRw_rX8E_jOobULJ5jB8NLftSBnYIcivum41vPWzM.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiIzNGE0MGEyOS1jZTY3LTRhZTktYWRjOS1iMTM2OTc5ZDJmNWMiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ)

| | In a culture that often tells moms their role doesn't matter, it's easy to forget the incredible influence you have every day. The truth is, strong families build strong communities, and strong communities build a strong nation. This week's blog explores five practical ways moms can make a lasting impact: by lifting their voices with courage, using their influence to protect their families, seeking wisdom and discernment, standing firm when their values are challenged, and raising children who love faith, freedom, and America. You don't need a public platform or elected office to make a difference. The conversations you have around your dinner table, the values you model, and the courage you show in your community all help shape the next generation. Every mom has been uniquely called to influence the future. Together, we can strengthen our families, inspire our communities, and help preserve the blessings of liberty for generations to come. Read the [full blog](https://momsforamerica.us/so/ffPzWzuB2/c?w=yx1mTmb7wOfaF7j1LBz2l7v9hFY5scIoQrMkbdf582w.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cubW9tc2ZvcmFtZXJpY2EudXMvYmxvZyIsInIiOiI3MDliNGEyMC02MWIwLTRiMzAtYWUzZi1mZWQ2NzJlNTE3N2EiLCJtIjoibWFpbCIsImMiOiJiMzgzOGJmOC1mYWIwLTQxYjktOTY3My1lOGM2YmVmYjY1NzcifQ) to discover all five ways you can use your God-given influence to help save the nation.

clean_body: Making a difference doesn't have to be complicated with Erica Choinka & Julianna Ormond | | Can 't see this message? | | | | | | | July 14, 2026 Newsletter | | Politics Doesn't Have to Be Complicated | | | | Politics can feel overwhelming, especially when the headlines never seem to stop. The good news is that understanding the issues that impact our families doesn't have to be complicated. Recorded live at CPAC, this week's podcast features two inspiring moms helping others make a difference. Erica Choinka, founder of Politics For Her, shares why public policy matters to moms and how she makes today's biggest issues easy to understand. Then, Julianna Ormond explains how her Watchman Action Training curriculum helps people turn passion into a practical plan for strengthening their communities. Whether you're just getting involved or looking for your next step, this conversation will encourage and equip you to make a difference where you live. Full episode available now on , , and . | | | | | | 5 Ways Moms Can Save the Nation | | | | In a culture that often tells moms their role doesn't matter, it's easy to forget the incredible influence you have every day. The truth is, strong families build strong communities, and strong communities build a strong nation. This week's blog explores five practical ways moms can make a lasting impact: by lifting their voices with courage, using their influence to protect their families, seeking wisdom and discernment, standing firm when their values are challenged, and raising children who love faith, freedom, and America. You don't need a public platform or elected office to make a difference. The conversations you have around your dinner table, the values you model, and the courage you show in your community all help shape the next generation. Every mom has been uniquely called to influence the future. Together, we can strengthen our families, inspire our communities, and help preserve the blessings of liberty for generations to come. Read the to discover all five ways you can use your God-given influence to help save the nation. | | | | Two hundred and fifty years ago, ordinary Americans did something extraordinary. They chose courage over comfort, faith over fear, and freedom over tyranny. Because they did, generations have enjoyed the blessings of liberty. Now it's our turn. Please help empower moms to raise families who love God and love their country. We launched the 1776 Club on Independence Day with a goal of 250 moms giving $17.76 a month by July 31st. Become one of our first 250 Founding Members and help inspire a new generation of moms to do something extraordinary. | | | | | | | | | In Truth & Liberty,Kimberly Fletcher Founder and PresidentMoms for America® | | | | | Visit our social accounts | | | | This email was sent from .

The National Library of Medicine says, “YES!”

Your feet have a natural recovery cycle that's supposed to kick in every night — calming irritated nerves and easing the swelling.

But after 50, that nightly recovery cycle slows down. So instead of waking up to calmer feet, you wake up to the same burning and tingling… or worse.

Here's the good news: you can give that nightly “foot reset” a jump-start — right from your recliner.

subject: Tim Burchett has no healthcare plan
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Michaela for Tennessee [www
body:
| |
---
But I do. This weekend, a man in Campbell County asked me a very smart question. Really, it was three questions packed into one. What is my long term plan for healthcare reform, what is my short term plan, and how do we connect the two? The American people have completely lost faith in our federal government, and honestly, can you blame them? Washington has turned into a playground for the wealthy and well-connected. Members of Congress spend half their days fundraising from elite corporate donors and the other half trading stocks based on confidential committee information.
My name is Mike Cortese. I am running for Congress in TN-04 and my diagnosis is simple: the system is fundamentally broken, and it's because career politicians have zero incentive to fix a system that**makes them rich.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/16878053-951e-47e4-8619-68e4cb3f6b07?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
**Help us clean up Washington.[Chip in $25 today to fund our fight for true government accountability.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/db6c71db-9cc8-4e90-8f05-895e94163bc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[It all starts HERE! Join Today!](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/db6c71db-9cc8-4e90-8f05-895e94163bc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I believe public service is a temporary sacrifice, not a lifetime career. On the Metro Council, transparency and strict ethical adherence aren't optional, they are expected. **We need to bring that exact same standard to the federal government.**
| [](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a4e1093a-cf94-45db-8fed-ca1da97f3cd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
When I am elected to represent the 4th District, I will fight for structural reforms: banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks, overturning _Citizens United_ to get dark money out of our politics, and implementing strict ethics rules for representatives and lobbyists alike.
If we want to change Washington, we have to change the types of people we send there. I am running a transparent, people-powered campaign. No corporate PACs, no hidden agendas, but [I need your help today.](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/db6c71db-9cc8-4e90-8f05-895e94163bc8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

name: Gina Hinojosa HQ
subject: A quick breakdown
body:
We promise this isn’t a long email, but these numbers are important. Please read:
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Let us break down some important numbers for you, Peter.
**$106 million**
That’s the massive billionaire backed warchest Greg Abbott has to hold on to his position as governor and stay in power.
**4 months**
That’s all the time we have left until Election Day. This fall, Texans will decide whether to finally reject Abbott at the polls or let him sell us out for another 4 years.
**3 points**
That’s the gap between Gina and Greg in the polls right now. That’s the closest anyone has come, and we know we have a real chance of closing this gap and winning.
**$1**
The amount we’re asking you to pitch in to Gina’s campaign. Here’s why:
We’re less than **24 hours** away from our fundraising numbers being locked in and made public for everyone to see — including Abbott’s team, who’ll be watching closely to gauge the strength of our grassroots team.

subject: Quick favor? Help us reach voters in VA-01 (It only takes 5 minutes!)
body:
Hi Petername,

To win in VA-01, we aren’t relying on flashy TV ads or generic billboards.
We are relying on you.

Research shows that the single most effective way to get someone to vote is
a personal message from a friend or family member. That is why we are
launching our Friends & Family Outreach Program to support Jason Knapp, and
we need your help to get it off the ground today.

It’s incredibly simple and takes less than five minutes. Here is how it
works:
1. Send us 15 contacts

Send us a list of 15 friends, family members, or neighbors who live in
Virginia's 1st Congressional District. For each person, we just need four
quick pieces of information:

-

First Name
-

Last Name
-

City
-

Age Range (e.g., 18–29, 30–45, etc.)

2. We do the heavy lifting

Our team will take your list and match it against the official voter file
to make sure we have the most accurate, up-to-date information.
3. You reach out (with our help!)

Once we’ve matched your list, we will send you a few quick, easy text
message templates. You just choose the one you like best, copy, paste, and
send it directly to your contacts. No awkward scripts—just a quick,
friendly nudge from someone they trust.

Ready to help Jason win?

Simply reply directly to this email with your list of 15 contacts.

Thank you for standing with Jason and helping us build this campaign from
the ground up.

Best,
Josh Harris

name: Anika Page
subject: You're Invited: A Celebration of Mississippi's Success
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/dome-dispatch-12853981?e=5703353baa)
---
|
---
| | Good morning Friend,
Every year, our annual gala brings together people from across Mississippi who care deeply about the future of our state. Business leaders, elected officials, community supporters, and friends of MCPP gather for an evening of thoughtful conversation, meaningful fellowship, and a shared commitment to the ideas that have helped Mississippi make remarkable progress. This year's A Celebration of Mississippi's Success promises to be one of our strongest programs yet. We are honored to welcome **Charles C.W. Cooke** , senior editor at _National Review_ , as our keynote speaker. Charles is one of the country's most respected conservative writers and commentators, offering thoughtful insight on the issues shaping our nation and the conservative movement. Joining him will be **Speaker of the House Jason White** , whose leadership has helped guide many of Mississippi's most significant policy reforms in recent years, along with **special guest Grover Norquist** , founder and president of Americans for Tax Reform.
---
| [ ](https://us.list-manage.com/1CnVpSFvI0n?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3)
---
| As Mississippi continues to earn national recognition for its achievements in education, economic growth, workforce development, and tax reform, there has never been a better time to celebrate the people and ideas helping move our state forward. Whether you've attended in the past or are considering joining us for the first time, we'd love to have you with us. **A Celebration of Mississippi's Success** 📅 Thursday, October 22, 2026 📍 Country Club of Jackson We hope you'll make plans to join us for what promises to be an outstanding evening. **Reserve your seat today →**
---
| [Reserve Your Seat Today!](https://us.list-manage.com/aMhKnD81XD2?e=5703353baa&c2id=0d4484d08dfcd99680c1a241a59ef3e3 "Reserve Your Seat Today!")

| We look forward to seeing you in October.
---
| |

Warmest regards,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

name: Shelley Hughes
subject: The People's Choice: Rally in the Valley Tonight
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alaskans for Hughes
body:
Big event, big momentum, and a ticket that keeps showing up for Alaska.

| | | | |
---
| | The People's Choice: Rally in the Valley Tonight!
---
**Greetings, Alaskans: ** **You can tell a lot about a campaign by where it shows up. This past week, Hughes/Gettys visited senior centers in Nikiski and Kenai, a unity rally in Fairbanks, a liberty meeting in Eagle River, and a parade route where volunteers pulled candy wagons and cheered their hearts out. That's not a campaign performing for cameras; that's the people's choice doing the work.**** ****The endorsements coming in reflect the same thing. Dr. Forrest Nabors, a political science professor (Chair of the Political Science Department at UAA) and Alaskan, put it plainly: Shelley is thoughtful, principled, pragmatic, and tough. Three Alaska Republican Party districts agree. And Blake Gettys, a 30-year Air Force veteran and brigadier general, isn't running for recognition; he's answering a call to serve with the same integrity he brought to three decades in uniform. This ticket has a record, a team already preparing to govern from day one, and the trust of Alaskans who've watched them keep their word.**** ****Tonight, we're bringing that energy to the Valley. Join us for the Rally in the Valley this evening and help us pack the room with 200 or more Alaskans who are ready to move this state forward. Scroll down for details, and we'll see you there.**

**Above: “I am Dr. Forrest Nabors, a professor of political science and an Alaskan. Among the many candidates running for governor this year, some have done their sincere best to serve our state well. Some are patriots. Some may still make contributions to our state and country. **
**This year I am endorsing Shelley Hughes for governor. Shelley’s tenure as a representative and senator in the Alaska legislature has prepared her for higher office. My former students and current friends know her, trust her, speak well of her and have set aside their private lives to work for her this election season. **
**On the debate stage on June 18th, Shelley stood out. She proved to me that she is thoughtful, principled, pragmatic and tough. Her approach to the development of Alaska’s natural gas is practical and sensitive to risks. She understands that your economic future depends on prudential management of our natural resources, and that in order to monetize those resources for maximum benefit to Alaska, the state government must get out of the way of private enterprise and let competition and new businesses thrive.**** ****She has organized teams of advisors who are right now preparing her future gubernatorial administration to act on Alaskans’ behalf from the moment she takes office. clean_body: Big event, big momentum, and a ticket that keeps showing up for Alaska. | | | | | | | The People's Choice: Rally in the Valley Tonight! Greetings, Alaskans: You can tell a lot about a campaign by where it shows up. This past week, Hughes/Gettys visited senior centers in Nikiski and Kenai, a unity rally in Fairbanks, a liberty meeting in Eagle River, and a parade route where volunteers pulled candy wagons and cheered their hearts out. That's not a campaign performing for cameras; that's the people's choice doing the work. The endorsements coming in reflect the same thing. Dr. Forrest Nabors, a political science professor (Chair of the Political Science Department at UAA) and Alaskan, put it plainly: Shelley is thoughtful, principled, pragmatic, and tough. Three Alaska Republican Party districts agree. And Blake Gettys, a 30-year Air Force veteran and brigadier general, isn't running for recognition; he's answering a call to serve with the same integrity he brought to three decades in uniform. This ticket has a record, a team already preparing to govern from day one, and the trust of Alaskans who've watched them keep their word. Tonight, we're bringing that energy to the Valley. Join us for the Rally in the Valley this evening and help us pack the room with 200 or more Alaskans who are ready to move this state forward. Scroll down for details, and we'll see you there. Please know not only does your support mean the world to us, but the very message that resonates with you, needs to get out across our huge state! I’m incredibly honored you’ve chosen to support our campaign. Together, we will rock this race! Every dollar moves us closer to the finish line. We’re not ashamed to say it: we need you! Donate at ~~ today! Your biggest advocate, Shelley HughesRepublican Candidate for Governor of the Great State of Alaska p.s. We are on the countdown to the August 18th Primary - we're now just 5 weeks away and collaboration with Alaskans who support our campaign across the state is needed now more than ever. Donations are important, link is below - but there are also other non-monetary ways to help us spread the word for Alaskans to vote Hughes/Gettys on August 18. Can you put a sign up on your property or at your place of business? Can you help us visit door-to-door with fellow Alaskans? Can you help stuff envelopes for upcoming mailers? Can you attend events in your community wearing our merch? Blake and I are super grateful for you to be behind us, encouraging us, and helping us get to Juneau to serve Alaskans and get things done. | ~~ "Donate Today!" | Campaign Fun in Eagle River at Bear Paw Festival Thank you to every volunteer who came out to support the Hughes/Gettys Campaign at the Bear Paw Parade. Whether you held signs, handed out candy, Shelley-phants, stickers, flyers, pulled the candy wagon, or cheered along the route, you made a difference. A special thank you to Cindy and Derick for creating such a fantastic float—your hard work blessed our entire team. Every single person played an important role, and together we demonstrated what true teamwork looks like. We are also grateful to your families for sharing your time with us. Eagle River showed us incredible encouragement and support today, and it was because of each of you we were able to represent our campaign so well. We thank God for each of you. May He richly bless you and your families. Please know you are deeply loved, sincerely appreciated, and an important part of this journey. Together, we continue to serve with grateful hearts and faith in what God has ahead. \- Team Hughes/Gettys ~ | Brave Nation Podcast: Shelley Hughes for Governor ~ "Meet Shelley Hughes, former Alaska state Senator and current candidate for Alaska Governor. Above: Shelley and Blake appreciated the time they had with the Kasilof Community Patriots and had a great discussion on a wide range of issues. Below: Shelley listening and engaging with Fairbanks residents at the Fairbanks Unity Rally. Below: Shelley with grandsons in Anchorage and on her way to Fairbanks to get her message out. They enjoyed spending time with their Mimi in the best state, being a part of the Hughes/Gettys July 4th parades, and of course, enjoying the great Alaskan outdoors! | Blake Gettys' #1 Supporter "I couldn’t be more proud of my husband, Brig. Gen. (Ret.) Blake Gettys. After 30 years of honorable service in the United States Air Force, he continues to answer the call to serve by running for Lieutenant Governor alongside Shelley Hughes. Blake is Christ-centered, selfless, obedient to God’s calling, and a man of unwavering character and impeccable ethics. He doesn’t seek recognition—he simply serves with integrity, humility, and a genuine love for Alaska and its people. If you believe Alaska deserves principled, servant-hearted leadership, please join me in supporting Alaskans for Hughes/Gettys. Together, we can put Alaska back on a path of strength, integrity, and opportunity." \- April Gettys | Where Will Hughes & Gettys Be Next? Your support matters. body:
https://va4reprofreedom.org/ [https://va4reprofreedom.org/]
This is it, Friend. In just about two months, early voting will begin for Virginia’s November 3 election.
We have an important question:
Are you ready to ENSHRINE reproductive freedom in our state’s constitution?
It may sound like a simple question, but generations have fought for and dreamed of this moment. Now, we can win it.
November 3, 2026 will be a historic day for Virginians. We want you to be a part of history — if you haven’t already, please join in with Repro champions across the Commonwealth and add your name to our scrapbook now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
Scrapbooks preserve the memories and milestones that matter most. We’ve created this one to demonstrate that support for reproductive freedom reaches every corner of the Commonwealth.
This scrapbook will help show that we’re prepared to vote a resounding “yes” in November no one can ignore. It will prove and record the strength of our movement.
SIGN THE SCRAPBOOK [https://secure.ngpvan.com/-40lN8qxGUmp0sfTv9rzsA2]
As the story of this movement continues to be written, we hope your name will be a part of it.
In community,
Hannah Servedio
Organizing Director
P.S. History is shaped by individuals like you who show up, speak out, and fight for what’s right. If you haven’t already, add your name to our scrapbook and help support our campaign. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=071426]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/vaforrepro-em?refcode=071426]

# Iran and Ceasefire
* **U.S. strikes Iran for the third straight night:** U.S. Central Command [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/24779c31-e33e-428c-9503-1d205e8e8104?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday afternoon, Eastern time, that it would begin yet another round of strikes on Iran, after which several explosions were reported across the country's south.
* Following the announcement, detonations were heard in Kish, Chabahar, Qeshm, and Bandar Abbas. Five additional explosions were [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/3085fd07-89cd-4668-8f92-2d99e700e442?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in Bandar Abbas on Tuesday morning.
* A U.S. strike on Hormozgan province [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/097cc800-ea23-4ca7-b989-8fee12484f06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) three people, all members of the same family, Iranian state media reported Tuesday.
* A separate U.S. strike wounded at least four people in the southwestern city of Omidiyeh.
* The latest wave of U.S strikes hit four locations in the strategically important city of Bushehr, according to Iran's state news agency IRNA.
* U.S. attacks hit the western cities of Mahshar and Abadan on Tuesday, both proximate to Iran's southwestern border with Iraq and close to Kuwait, IRNA reported.
* **Iran responds, hits two tankers in the Strait:** Two Iranian cruise missiles [struck](https://substack.com/redirect/220619c3-127d-4d27-ac57-7d28def7d5c3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) two different UAE oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz early Tuesday, killing one crew member and wounding eight, according to an announcement from the Emirati Ministry of Defense, which condemned the attack as "brazen" and noted that it reserved its right to respond.
* The tankers, the Mombasa and Al Bahiyah, were hit in the strait's southern shipping lane, in Omani territorial waters, according to the statement.
* An Indian crew member aboard the Mombasa was killed, and six other Indian nationals were wounded. Two Ukrainian nationals were wounded as well. India summoned Iran's deputy ambassador in response on Tuesday.
* A statement from the IRGC [said](https://substack.com/redirect/ff121e7b-3cb8-4683-9754-5a290e786607?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the ships had transited the Strait in violation of its announced protocol, calling them "offending supertankers" and alleging that they had "switched off their navigation systems and ignored repeated warnings" from Iran's Maritime Security Control Center.
* Iran has maintained that management of the Strait remains under its control, according to memorandum of understanding, and that navigation be conducted through its northern route, rather than through the southern U.S.-backed corridor along the Omani coast.
* It also [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/ff121e7b-3cb8-4683-9754-5a290e786607?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) regional states against "cooperating with an aggressive enemy that has come from thousands of kilometers away to violate the rights of [the Gulf's] people."
* The UKTMO reported that two additional ships were struck while transiting the Strait on Tuesday, though it has yet to provide identifying information.
* Bahrain's General Command [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/f1ee5958-6c9d-4030-b5ee-180690321199?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that it foiled several attacks on Tuesday, urging citizens to exercise caution while hostilities continue. Jordan [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/b0070f68-e1d0-4e47-b225-668fb8af7be6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) similar interceptions.
* The Iranian military also claimed to have shot down three of the U.S.'s "LUCAS" drones in airspace over Bandar Abbas, according to the semi-official Mehr News Agency
* **U.S. to resume blockade on Iran:** U.S. Central Command [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/113ef4ba-9d98-4bf5-82fa-029d5076f731?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday that it would resume its blockade on vessels entering or leaving Iranian ports, and would start doing so on Tuesday at 4 p.m. ET.
* According to its statement, U.S. forces will target ships transiting to or from Iranian ports and coastal areas while continuing to allow other commercial traffic through regional waters.

* **Trump threatens to strike Iranian nuclear site:** In an interview on Monday, President Donald Trump [threatened](https://substack.com/redirect/d44ac3db-3846-4e1a-81a7-b2610a5fcea2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to strike Iran's Pickaxe Mountain nuclear site, telling radio host Hugh Hewitt it was "on the list."
* In the same interview, he called the MOU a "test" rather than a deal, and argued that it showed his Iranian counterparts to be "extremely unreliable."
* He bragged to Hewitt about "knocking out" two Iranian governments and killing "about 25%" of Iran's current leadership and intimated he knew the location of others.

* **Iranian military reiterates U.S. will not have any role in Hormuz administration:**
* In a statement on Tuesday morning, and following Trump's statement regarding controlling the Strait of Hormuz and charging a 20% fee on all cargo shipped, IRGC spokesman Brigadier General Mohammad Akraminia [said](https://substack.com/redirect/a47874c5-3b25-469a-84e9-ad444f1bc2f0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that the Strait would never be opened by "war, evil, and American aggression," according to the Mehr news agency. "We are obligated to avenge the blood of the martyrs, especially the martyred leader of the Islamic Revolution," Akraminia said.

* **Iran continues to ship oil:** Iran [continues](https://substack.com/redirect/5a72da65-5c5d-455a-aac2-1e0269236ba2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to export oil despite the termination of sanctions waivers, oil minister Mohsen Paknejad said on Tuesday.
* Because Iranians had expected that their American counterparts would break the agreement, Paknejad said, "the structures...for the continuation of oil exports" were maintained, and "the country's oil export process continues as before."
* Iran has shipped out 80 million barrels of crude oil in the past four weeks, TankerTrackers reported on Tuesday, though 30 million barrels ready to export have yet to depart.
* **Omani FM calls war a "disaster": **Omani Foreign Minister Badr Al-Busaidi [called](https://substack.com/redirect/a75d4b89-5754-4342-90fe-8ce964f4e3e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the war on Iran a "disaster" in an opinion piece published by the French newspaper Le Monde on Monday, saying that the war "has achieved none of its officially assigned objectives" and lacks a UN mandate.
* In the piece, he condemned Israel specifically for its aggression, saying it posed a greater threat to the region than Iran.
* Busaidi said in the piece that "complex talks" had "begun to shape a lasting framework guaranteeing freedom of navigation in the Strait of Hormuz," adding that it is "incumbent" upon his country to work with Iran and the rest of the international community to produce an arrangement that is "realistic, sustainable, and compliant with international law."
* He expressed optimism that, if anything, the war might lead to "the emergence of a fairer, more realistic and more effective system."
* **European agency tells flights not to operate over Gulf states:** The European Aviation Safety Agency [warned](https://substack.com/redirect/cd69a8f6-5062-481a-814b-c6607d4dba20?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) airlines to avoid Kuwait, Bahrain, Qatar, the UAE, and their surrounding waters on Tuesday, citing "unpredictable military developments" in the region.
* Last week, it told airlines to avoid Iran, Iraq, and Lebanon.

# Lebanon
* **Israel continues attacks in Lebanon despite "framework agreement":**
* Two people were [injured](https://substack.com/redirect/cc35c2bf-6e63-4733-8676-0e4ac1df9a49?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) after an Israeli drone carried out an airstrike on the town of Nabatieh Al-Fawqa in the Nabatieh district in southern Lebanon on Tuesday. The strike came after Israeli forces detonated explosives in the areas of Nabatieh Al-Fawqa and Kfartebnit, Lebanon's National News Agency (NNA) reported.
* Israeli forces also [demolished](https://substack.com/redirect/1a94a4ef-9d9c-4c2c-af02-420e718e4069?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) several homes and infrastructure in the towns of Majdal Zoun and Haddatha before dawn on Tuesday.
* Israeli shelling was [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/1a94a4ef-9d9c-4c2c-af02-420e718e4069?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in the town of Biyout Al Sayyad on Tuesday morning, and explosions were heard near the towns of Tayri and Kounine overnight.

* **Killed and wounded:** Over the last 24 hours, two Palestinians were killed and 21 were injured in Israeli attacks across Gaza, according to the Palestinian Ministry of Health.
* The total recorded death toll since October 7, 2023 has risen to 73,233 killed, with 173,707 injured. Since October 11, the first full day of the so-called ceasefire, Israel has killed at least 1,110 Palestinians in Gaza and wounded 3,599, while 800 bodies have been recovered from under the rubble.

Gaza's Interior Ministry said the dead included the head of the Jabalia refugee camp police station, along with several officers. The UN has documented Israel's killings of dozens of police personnel in Gaza in 2026 alone. "The pattern of attacks raises concerns that Israeli forces apply no distinction between police personnel and fighters belonging to armed groups in Gaza. However, under international humanitarian law, police personnel are civilians who are protected against attack," the UN Human Rights Office said in a statement last month. "Attacks targeting police personnel simply for performing ordinary law enforcement and policing functions would amount to war crimes."
* A man was killed and three others wounded, including a child and a woman, in an Israeli strike on the Qadisiya camp in the Mawasi area of Khan Younis, in southern Gaza.
* Another man died of wounds sustained two days earlier in an Israeli strike on the Qadisiya camp, west of Khan Younis.
* A child, Motaz Abu Shaar, was killed by Israeli gunfire in the Mawasi area of Rafah, southern Gaza Strip.

* **Watch Mohamed Ahmed 's full video dispatch [here](https://substack.com/redirect/2a1f284b-b27a-47de-ad1d-901eccfc474c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).**

It said the intervention came in response to repeated UN requests for security protection at aid sites, and that a few cigarette cartons were stolen when a crowd gathered.

* **Marwan Barghouti shot with rubber bullet as global campaign for his release grows:** The wife of imprisoned Palestinian leader Marwan Barghouti, Fadwa Barghouti, [said](https://substack.com/redirect/3d8f038e-d776-44a4-b039-87cf6bf8bd0a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Monday that an "inciting" report issued by the Israel Prison Service coincided with a prison guard shooting Barghouti in the leg with a rubber bullet inside his cell, causing bleeding and a painful injury. Instead, Israeli prison authorities have [introduced](https://substack.com/redirect/3265345b-d2d0-4976-8eb9-782ff1b45ae1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) new restrictions limiting ICRC access to one visit per prison every three months, requiring advance lists of up to five prisoners, while excluding detainees in solitary confinement, under interrogation, or classified as "highly violent." The new rules also cap visits at 30 minutes, allow prison commanders to end them early, require interviews to take place behind partitions via intercom, and prohibit ICRC delegates from requesting medical examinations or bringing communication and recording devices. Human rights groups say the measures undermine the High Court's ruling and will make it more difficult to monitor and document abuse inside Israeli prisons.

* **DMFI attacks Ro Khanna for his West Bank detention:** Democratic Majority for Israel, an influential pro-Israel advocacy and fundraising group, [released](https://substack.com/redirect/bf2d5b81-ee0e-4969-a5eb-c6fefceb68fc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a video Saturday of Kathy Manning, its board chair, attacking Rep. * **ICE kills man in Maine:** An ICE agent shot and [killed](https://substack.com/redirect/24e3a9b1-31a1-4699-8d44-7431b856f5a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a motorist in Biddeford, Maine, on Monday morning, the second killing by an ICE agent of a civilian this week and the ninth since Trump took office in 2025.

* **Trump notifies Congress U.S. is again at war with Iran, restarting 60-day war powers clock:** President Donald Trump formally [notified](https://substack.com/redirect/10e4d589-92a6-46f8-978d-803d5bbca956?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) lawmakers in a letter dated July 10 that the U.S. is again at war with Iran, restarting a 60-day clock allowing military action without congressional approval and describing strikes that began July 7 as necessary to protect Americans and U.S. interests, Politico reported on Monday.

* **Trump shrinks two Utah national monuments by more than a million acres each** : President Donald Trump [signed](https://substack.com/redirect/06462d95-5a4c-456e-9707-2a8756aeb345?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) orders Monday, shrinking Utah's Grand Staircase-Escalante National Monument from about 1.87 million acres to roughly 181,500 acres and Bears Ears National Monument from about 1.36 million acres to roughly 121,100 acres, opening land containing coal, uranium, oil, and gas deposits to potential development, the Washington Post reported.
* The move, which exceeds cuts Trump made to the monuments in 2017 before President **Joe Biden** reversed them, drew criticism from tribal groups and environmental advocates. "Our Tribes were not informed of or asked about this decision, and that's unacceptable," a Paiute leader said in response to the decision.

Discovery merger: **A coalition of 12 state attorneys general, led by California Attorney General **Rob Bonta** , [filed](https://substack.com/redirect/6c2b74ab-d611-4c44-8dfd-90cfd4a75ac8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a federal antitrust lawsuit on Monday in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California to block Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. * **Judge rules Trump 's $10 billion IRS lawsuit was filed for "improper purpose":** U.S. District Judge **Kathleen Williams** [ruled](https://substack.com/redirect/d11f4af4-0771-4750-8a50-b567f90b182a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on Monday that President Donald Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS over his leaked tax returns was filed for an improper purpose, accusing Trump and his lawyers of manipulating the courts by suing a federal agency under his own control and calling the resulting settlement, which granted Trump immunity from tax audits, an exercise in self-dealing, the Associated Press reported.
* "Whether Executive Branch actors can privately agree to give themselves and their former clients blanket immunities and billions of dollars in tax monies for legally undefined grievances was never an issue advanced to this Court," Williams said.
* Williams referred Trump attorney **Alejandro Brito** for possible disciplinary action before the Florida bar, barred lawyer **Daniel Epstein** from filing in the Southern District of Florida for up to a year, and forwarded her ruling to bar authorities in New York and Washington, D.C.

Henry McMaster appoints Graham 's sister to his seat: **South Carolina's Republican governor [appointed](https://substack.com/redirect/adb7496e-5e2a-4047-9264-77bea04558b3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) **Darline Graham Nordone** , the sister of the recently deceased Sen. **Lindsay Graham** , to fill his U.S. Senate seat on Monday. * **Trump 's former campaign manager running floundering Israeli influence operation: **Israel and the Trump administration are both reportedly [unhappy](https://substack.com/redirect/3a604982-75fa-4858-a69d-f66d9a9d6a7c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with former Trump campaign manager **Brad Parscale 's** campaign to influence MAGA voters to support the country, Time reported on Tuesday
* The campaign came under additional scrutiny when several MAGA influencers posted similar attacks on Trump's June 17 ceasefire agreement with Iran, often using nearly identical language at roughly the same time, with some sharing an Israeli op-ed titled "You Could Have Been the Greatest President of All--But You Failed." Time reported that Parscale distributed suggested messaging to conservative influencers through private group chats, with some creators paid based on their posts' reach and engagement.

* Time cited Pew data showing just 32% of Americans now view the Israeli government favorably, the lowest level in decades.

* **China denies that it seeks a "sphere of influence" in dealings with Pacific nations: **Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi [told](https://substack.com/redirect/89947b93-4ad2-4e54-afd4-b713628cd966?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) his counterpart from the Solomon Islands that China "has no geopolitical intentions and does not seek a so-called 'sphere of influence'" in the Pacific during a Tuesday meeting, according to Reuters.

* Yi reaffirmed the sovereignty of Solomon Islands and their neighbors in Oceania, saying they were "not someone's backyard" and "should not be subject to interference from any third party."
* The remarks come after Solomon Islands criticized a Chinese test launch in the South Pacific last week, with the country's prime minister saying that China is "a good friend of the Solomon Islands, but this is not something a friend does," and suggesting the maneuver would draw the nation closer to Australia, which signed a mutual defence pact with Fiji on Monday.
* **Hungarian Parliament votes to remove its President:** Hungary's Parliament [approved](https://substack.com/redirect/7940bd5c-4a28-4b2e-945a-3ca0a6333279?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a constitutional amendment on Monday to remove current President Tamas Sulyok from his position.
* Sulyok is a member of former Prime Minister Viktor Orban's right-wing Fidesz Party and took office in 2024.
* Orban was defeated in April's elections and was replaced by Peter Magyar, the head of the center-right Tisza party.
* Magyar has spent much of his early term attempting to remove and replace officials associated with Orban, who governed the country for 16 years.
* Sulyok has five days to sign the order demanding his own removal. Parliament has indicated it will open impeachment hearings into Sulyok if he fails to do so.
* **UK arrests 12 people accused of plotting terrorist attack against Muslims:** British police [arrested](https://substack.com/redirect/86f62e6f-8de8-469d-9b75-32edb37e207e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) 12 people suspected of plotting terrorist attacks against an Islamic gathering held in the eastern part of the country over the weekend, according to an announcement from the UK's Counter Terrorism Command's London Office.
* Arrests were made across the country on Sunday and Monday, the office said.
* The majority of the suspects, whose ages ranged from 27 to 82, were white men, though one woman was arrested in connection with the plot.
* The Ijtima festival, the target of the threats, was visited by an estimated 15,000 people.
